## Buyer guidance
INRISHI scopes software around the actual business workflow rather than forcing a fixed template. CRM and Employee Management publicly start from ₹15,000 + GST. The standard business website package is ₹25,000 + GST with ₹1,500 annual maintenance. AI automation is quoted after workflow study.
